# The `window.Opem` surface

The script tag defines `window.Opem`; `@opem/browser` exports the same object for bundlers (`import { Opem } from "@opem/browser"`), and `@opem/react` wraps it (`OpemProvider`, `OpemButton`, `useOpem`). Nothing touches the page until `init` runs, so the module can be imported during server rendering.

## API

```ts
export const DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://support.opem.app";

export interface InitOptions {
  /** The project's publishable key, `pk_…`. */
  projectKey: string;
  /** Where the Opem API lives. The script-tag build defaults to the origin it was loaded from. */
  baseUrl?: string;
  /** Forces light or dark; `system` (the default) follows the visitor's `prefers-color-scheme`. */
  theme?: ThemeMode;
  position?: Position;
  /** `false` hides the Help button, for hosts that open the widget from their own trigger. */
  launcher?: boolean;
  /** A CSS selector or an element; clicking it toggles the widget. */
  trigger?: string | Element;
  /** Extra page context the host chooses to send with requests (used from Phase 1). */
  context?: () => HostContext;
  /**
   * String overrides by key. Applied only when the plan includes custom strings; the project's
   * strings from `/config` win over them.
   */
  strings?: Partial<Record<string, string>>;
  /** Called for every widget event, after the handlers registered with `on`. */
  onEvent?: (event: OpemEventName, payload: unknown) => void;
}

export interface HostContext {
  pageTitle?: string;
  pagePath?: string;
  extra?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface Identity {
  /** The host's stable identifier for the person: its user id, a customer number. */
  id: string;
  email?: string;
  name?: string;
  traits?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>;
  /**
   * The person's roles in the host's app; the assistant then answers from documents tagged with
   * them too. Signed with the id and email, they count while the signature verifies, for a day.
   * Unsigned, they count only where the project trusts unsigned roles, and are dropped elsewhere.
   */
  roles?: string[];
  /**
   * When the host's server signed the roles, in unix seconds: needed with roles and a signature, and
   * they lapse a day later. Unsigned roles need none.
   */
  signedAt?: number;
  /** HMAC of the id, email and roles with the project's verification secret, computed on the host's server. */
  signature?: string;
}

export interface OpenOptions {
  tab?: Tab;
  /** Preselects a request kind on the New request tab, which opens unless `tab` names another. */
  kind?: string;
  /** Pins an error's digest to the New request form, which opens unless `tab` names another. */
  error?: unknown;
  /**
   * Starts the request's message with this text (at most 200 characters) when the person has not
   * typed one; a request has no separate title. New request opens unless `tab` names another.
   */
  title?: string;
  /**
   * Starts "Capture this tab" as New request opens, as if the person had pressed it, so a host's own
   * button can open a request with a screenshot ready. Call it from that button's click: the browser
   * asks to share the tab only within the click's user activation. Does nothing where the browser
   * cannot capture a tab.
   */
  screenshot?: boolean;
}

/** What `Opem.context()` tells the widget about the page, the shorthand for `init({ context })`. */
export interface PageContext {
  /** The route as your app names it, starting with "/"; kept on the page's origin. */
  page?: string;
  title?: string;
  extra?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface OpemApi {
  init(options: InitOptions): void;
  identify(identity: Identity): void;
  reset(): void;
  open(options?: OpenOptions): void;
  open(tab: Tab, options?: Omit<OpenOptions, "tab">): void;
  /** Sets the page context sent with a question or a request; the last call, or `init({ context })`, wins. */
  context(context: PageContext): void;
  close(): void;
  toggle(): void;
  reportError(error: unknown): void;
  on(event: OpemEventName, handler: OpemEventHandler): () => void;
  badge(): number;
}
```

## Types the API uses

```ts
/**
 * Theme tokens. Every widget component reads colours, radius and type from these CSS custom
 * properties and never from fixed values, so a project's appearance settings can replace them.
 * The defaults are the neutral Opem look from DESIGN.md (decision 0005): ink on a white canvas
 * with the tint ladder, the radius scale (8px controls, 12px cards) and no shadows; the panel stands apart from the
 * page by a hairline. Dark is the polarity inversion. Muted text is #6b6b6b, as in packages/ui,
 * so it meets AA on the canvas-soft track.
 */

export type ThemeMode = "system" | "light" | "dark";

export type Tab = "ask" | "request" | "requests";

export const tabs: readonly Tab[] = ["ask", "request", "requests"];

export type Position = "bottom-right" | "bottom-left";

export const eventNames = [
  "open",
  "close",
  "navigate",
  "request:sent",
  "request:replied",
  "ask:answered",
] as const;

export type OpemEventName = (typeof eventNames)[number];

export type OpemEventHandler = (payload: unknown) => void;
```
